verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is explicitly documented as secure, isolated containers/VMs for executing untrusted user or agent code, with network isolation controls, filesystem access, snapshots, and dedicated agent-code-execution examples showing arbitrary code run safely; community use (self-hosted runners, agent runtimes) corroborates real-world usage. missing for 10: independent third-party security audits or documented isolation-breakout testing, and clearer guarantees on infra-risk isolation beyond docs/examples.
